name: printful-mcp
description: Printful API for agents: an MCP server with 32 tools and a CLI, on one shared core.

interface.shortDescription: Print-on-demand catalog, orders, mockups and shipping.
interface.longDescription: An MCP server exposing 32 Printful tools — catalog browsing, order drafting and confirmation, mockup generation, shipping and tax rates, file uploads, store and sync-product management — plus a `printful` CLI over the same shared core.
